evidence_classes.technical_provenance: Identity, lineage, hash, timestamp, acquisition, stream, range, or build evidence. It does not prove permission.
evidence_classes.content_identity: The exact audiovisual work, caption text, font bytes, or generated layer being considered. Identity does not establish ownership.
evidence_classes.content_observation: A bounded human or image-based observation of visible or audible content. It does not establish ownership or permission.
evidence_classes.primary_terms: Terms or guidelines published by the relevant platform, publisher, or font distributor. Applicability to this use remains an owner decision.
evidence_classes.license_or_terms_evidence: A primary license, guideline, or terms proposition with document identity and retrieval date. It remains separate from exact-use permission.
evidence_classes.owner_representation: A representation by a person with recorded identity and authority about ownership or decision capacity. No such representation is currently recorded.
evidence_classes.permission_or_owner_authority: A permission, license binding, or decision-maker authority record that can support an allow, deny, or restricted verdict.
evidence_classes.attribution_obligation: A source, creator, license, or policy credit requirement to be recorded in the final restricted or allowed use.
evidence_classes.territorial_platform_monetization_restri: A territory, platform, visibility, duration, monetization, channel-registration, or takedown condition on the contemplated use.
evidence_classes.unresolved_legal_or_policy_question: A question that the human owner, policy owner, or qualified adviser must resolve; the packet does not provide a legal conclusion.
evidence_classes.editorial_acceptance: The existing internal editorial review receipt. It does not expand into rights, production, or publication approval.
evidence_classes.platform_policy: Platform publication or monetization policy that constrains the intended use but does not grant underlying rights.

primary_authorities.title: hololive production Derivative Works Guidelines
decision_propositions: The overall derivative-work guidelines and the clip-specific guidelines both need consideration for clips.
Third-party intellectual property follows the relevant third-party terms.
Paid, members-only, or concert content is not within the ordinary clip path absent express permission.
The clip description should begin with the source URL and source title.
Monetization depends on compliance with the guidelines, platform rules, and third-party conditions.
Content ID registration is not proposed.
The guidelines may change and do not transfer COVER-owned rights.
Use with no or only minimal creative modification needs an explicit applicability assessment.

primary_authorities.title: ポップ体フォント「けいふぉんと！」のダウンロード
decision_propositions: The primary distribution page describes commercial use as not specially restricted.
The page asks users to avoid contexts that harm the work that inspired the font.
The page identifies upstream glyph sources and owners.
The page states that the font may be used under Apache License 2.0.

primary_authorities.title: YouTube Terms of Service
decision_propositions: Service access does not itself grant rights in content uploaded by other users.
Uploading content requires the uploader to hold the necessary rights or legal entitlement.
The contemplated publication grants YouTube the platform license described in its terms.

primary_authorities.title: YouTube channel monetization policies
decision_propositions: Reused-content review is channel-wide and separate from copyright or permission.
Monetization review considers meaningful original commentary, modification, or added value.
Permission alone does not resolve reused-content monetization review.

primary_authorities.title: What kind of content can I monetize?
decision_propositions: Monetization requires the necessary commercial rights for the visual and audio elements.
Online availability by itself does not supply those rights.
Written permission or another rights basis may be needed depending on the material and use.
